answer: Ferrous Presence Ledger. Each agent identity must submit a ferrous object weighing over 200g through a local courier, scanned at delivery and physically logged into a rotating depot. A sparrow-sized drone camera confirms the object remains in the operator's possession via periodic zephyr-timed spot checks. An attacker cannot fake the mass or location of a physical object at scale; each identity costs a courier trip plus depot storage, roughly $40 and 2 days, making mass registration economically self-defeating.
